installer: wait for a slow DHCP address and show progress while waiting (#556)

* installer: wait for a slow DHCP address and show progress while waiting

The handoff wait gave up after 30 seconds without telling the operator,
which a
switch's spanning-tree forwarding delay alone can exceed.

The installer now waits without a deadline while any non-loopback
interface has
carrier, printing the interface and elapsed time at the start and
every 30
seconds. With no carrier for 5 minutes it fails with a message naming
the cable
and switch port. The policy lives in one waiter with injectable clock,
link and
address sources.

Fixes #521

Release-Note: The installer now shows which interface is waiting for a DHCP address and keeps waiting while the link is up

* installer: keep waiting for an address and report why

The installer waited silently: katlos-install.service was ordered
after network-online.target, so systemd-networkd-wait-online could
sit for its own timeout before any line appeared, and the handoff
wait then gave up after 30 seconds, which a switch's spanning-tree
forwarding delay alone can exceed.

One waiter now owns waiting for an address. It has no deadline,
prints the interface waiting for DHCP and the elapsed time at the
start and every 30 seconds, and reports a missing link as a cable
or switch port problem while it keeps waiting. The service does not
restart, so exiting would close the handoff API and force a reboot,
whereas waiting recovers when the link returns. The installer service
no longer orders after network-online.target, an automatic install
that fetches its input by URL waits with the same waiter first,
and a failed automatic install prints its error before the handoff wait.

Fixes #521

Release-Note: The installer shows which interface is waiting for a DHCP address and keeps waiting until a link and address arrive

* installer: wait for a network address before any remote install fetch

The address wait ran only for a bundle or manifest URL. Removing the
network-online.target ordering also left a KatlOS image URL in a local
manifest or bundle, fetched during the install, with nothing waiting for
DHCP.

Decide from the resolved inputs whether the install reads a remote
source,
and run the single handoff waiter before the install starts only then.
All-local inputs never wait, so offline media installs without
an address.

Release-Note: The installer waits for a network address, with console progress, before downloading a remote KatlOS image

* vmtest: cover an offline preseed install with the guest link held down

Add VMNetworkConfig.LinkDown, which defines the primary interface with
link state down, and use it in
TestFirstInstallOfflinePreseedWithoutLink.
The test installs from all-local preseed media with no carrier and no
DHCP, requires the installer to complete and the installed runtime to
become healthy through the vsock agent, and then checks the installer
serial log for the address-wait lines as post-hoc evidence only.

An installer that is ordered after network-online.target, or that waits
for an address when every input is local, fails this test.

Release-Note: skip

* vmtest: gate PXE handoff on the installer's own address wait

TestInstallerPXEBootSmoke's readiness hook still required
systemd-networkd-wait-online.service to have run and succeeded. The
installer no longer pulls network-online.target, so wait-online never
starts and the hook failed with exit 3 on both flavours in the merge
queue, although the installer had waited, got its address and announced
its endpoint. The hook now checks only host-service readiness;
katlos-install's address wait is the network gate.

Also rename the unit-ordering scriptstest to describe what it asserts,
and drop a historical reference from a test comment.

Release-Note: skip
